dct_title_s: Vietnam Hanoi, Typhoon Maysak: Flood Proxy Map, Jul 2026
dct_description_sm: # EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Hanoi, Vietnam, Typhoon Maysak, 08 July 2026, v0.4 The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created this preliminary Flood Proxy Map (FPM) depicting areas that are likely flooded around Hanoi, Vietnam, due to Typhoon Maysak which made landfall on 05 July 2026. This map was derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired by the ALOS-4 satellites operated by the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) using a pre-event acquisition of 13 April 2026 and a post-event acquisition of 06 July 2026. The map covers an area indicated by the white polygon. The preliminary map shows areas which are likely flooded (shown by light blue pixels of approximately 30m in size) due to heavy rainfall. Preliminary validation was conducted using news reports and ground-level imagery and video in selected areas. This map should be used as a guide to identify areas that are likely flooded, and may be less reliable over urban and vegetated areas. ALOS-4 data were provided by JAXA and analyzed by the Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS). **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Original data ALOS-4 PALSAR-3 Products - JAXA (2026)
